title: The Panda Day
summary: 动物园观察:主角和妈妈去看熊猫,熊猫吃竹子、熊猫宝宝玩球摔倒,愉快的一天。
text: Last week, {{name}} visited the zoo with Mom. {{name}} wanted to see the pandas. The pandas lived in a big house. One panda sat by a tree. It was fat and very cute. "Look, Mom! It eats and eats!" The little panda liked the bamboo. It ate a lot of bamboo. Then a baby panda walked out. It was small and black and white. The baby panda played with a ball. It fell down, but it was okay. {{name}} laughed and laughed. "Mom, can we stay here all day?" "No, but we can come back," said Mom. "Pandas need to sleep too," she said. {{name}} said bye to the pandas. "Bye, little pandas! See you soon!" It was a happy day at the zoo.

questions.prompt: What did the baby panda play with?
